x: Eric Herbert ran an excellent race to finish third to Gosney and Barry in the Civil Service C.C.

Those who were fortunate enough to get in front of the field over the first mile stayed there, and during the whole race the leading men remained the same, Frank Abberton, Bowering (S.L.H.) and Barry (H.H.H.) fighting for first place, Bill Lucas and Marchant being a few places further back.

Archie Bedford ran a good mile to lose by inches to Barry of Herne Hill in 4 mins. 29 secs. but we managed to win the medley relay. A few junior events were also on the programme and Wolton was third in the 880 yards.

The conditions sadly affected our field event men with Nick Head being injured in the Javelin, our two Long Jumpers suffering from the anti-climax of their performances the previous week and Barry Townsend recovering from the SCAAA Decathlon held the day before.
To Kitty and Barry we offer our heartfelt sympathies.
